reason: Cloudflare Worker registers callable read-only GA4 Admin/Data API tools alongside Search Console tools; handlers perform authenticated Google REST requests.

tools.name: ga4_list_account_summaries
tools.description: List all Google Analytics 4 accounts and properties accessible to the authenticated user. Use this to discover property IDs needed for run_report.
tools.behavior: Issues an authenticated GET to https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com/v1beta/accountSummaries?pageSize=200. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: Returns a single page (pageSize=200); does not follow nextPageToken.

tools.name: ga4_get_property_details
tools.description: Get details about a specific GA4 property (timezone, currency, industry, etc.).

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. 123456789 or properties/123456789

tools.behavior: Normalizes bare property ID to properties/ID. Issues an authenticated GET to https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com/v1beta/${pid}. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: Run a Google Analytics 4 report. Returns metrics broken down by dimensions for a date range. Common dimensions: date, country, deviceCategory, sessionDefaultChannelGroup, pagePath, landingPage. Common metrics: sessions, totalUsers, newUsers, screenPageViews, conversions, totalRevenue, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or relative like today, yesterday

metrics.description: List of metric names, at least one required

tools.behavior: Normalizes property ID; builds one date range, metric name objects, optional dimension name objects, stringified limit and parsed dimensionFilter; POSTs the report request. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: Invalid dimension_filter JSON is silently ignored.
The description promises at least one metric and max 100000 rows, but schema/handler impose neither minimum array length nor numeric range/integer constraint.

tools.name: ga4_run_realtime_report
tools.description: Run a Google Analytics 4 realtime report. Returns active users data from the last 30 minutes.
tools.behavior: Normalizes property ID; POSTs metric name objects and optional dimension name objects for realtime reporting. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List all Search Console properties accessible to the authenticated user.
tools.behavior: Issues an authenticated GET to https://www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/sites. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: gsc_query_search_analytics
tools.description: Query Search Console search analytics. Returns clicks, impressions, CTR, position for the given site, date range, and dimensions. Common dimensions: query, page, country, device, date, searchAppearance.

site_url.description: Site URL, e.g. https://www.example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

tools.behavior: URL-encodes site URL; POSTs startDate/endDate, rowLimit, optional dimensions and parsed dimensionFilterGroups. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: Invalid dimension_filter_groups JSON is silently ignored; parsed values receive no structural validation.

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List sitemaps submitted to Search Console for a given site.
tools.behavior: URL-encodes site URL; Issues an authenticated GET to https://www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/sites/${encoded}/sitemaps. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: Inspect a specific URL in Search Console (indexation status, last crawl, mobile usability, etc.). Powered by Google's URL Inspection API.
tools.behavior: POSTs inspectionUrl, siteUrl and languageCode (default en-CA) to URL Inspection. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: gsc_get_sitemap
tools.description: Get details of a specific sitemap submitted to Search Console (status, last submitted, last downloaded, warnings, errors, contents).

feedpath.description: Full URL of the sitemap, e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml

tools.behavior: URL-encodes site URL and sitemap feedpath; Issues an authenticated GET to https://www.googleapis.com/webmasters/v3/sites/${encodedSite}/sitemaps/${encodedFeed}. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: ga4_get_metadata
tools.description: List all dimensions and metrics available for a specific GA4 property (including custom dimensions/metrics). Use this to discover what you can query in run_report.
tools.behavior: Normalizes bare property ID to properties/ID. Issues an authenticated GET to https://analyticsdata.googleapis.com/v1beta/${pid}/metadata. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).

tools.name: ga4_check_compatibility
tools.description: Check which dimensions and metrics are compatible with a given report configuration. Useful for diagnosing why a runReport returns errors.
tools.behavior: Normalizes property ID; POSTs compatibilityFilter (falls back to COMPATIBLE for absent or empty string) and optional dimension/metric name objects. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: compatibility_filter is unrestricted string, not an enum; COMPATIBLE is a handler fallback rather than a schema default.

tools.name: ga4_run_pivot_report
tools.description: Run a GA4 pivot report (pivot tables with multiple pivots). Returns metrics aggregated by pivot dimensions.

pivots.description: JSON string of pivots array, e.g. '[{"fieldNames":["country"],"limit":10}]'

tools.behavior: Normalizes property ID; POSTs one date range, dimension and metric name objects, and the JSON-parsed pivots value. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: Invalid pivots JSON silently becomes []; parsed value receives no structural validation.

tools.name: ga4_batch_run_reports
tools.description: Run up to 5 GA4 reports in a single request, sharing the same property. Saves quota when you need several reports for the same property.

requests_json.description: JSON array of up to 5 request objects, each with dateRanges/dimensions/metrics

tools.behavior: Normalizes property ID; JSON-parses requests_json and POSTs it as requests. Returns the API response as pretty-printed JSON text (or raw text).
notes: Invalid requests_json silently becomes []; no array shape or five-request maximum is enforced locally.

Source review only; no tools/list, server execution or live requests. HEAD matches supplied revision.
All 22 tools register unconditionally in MyMCP.init; no optional tool modules or permission tiers. OAuth and aliases are HTTP endpoints, not tools.
ALIAS_PATHS changes connector routing, not tool names/inventory; optional PATH_EMAIL_MAP restricts who may open each exact path (src/index.ts:456-515,621-655).

Google OAuth requests analytics.readonly and webmasters.readonly scopes (src/google-handler.ts:128-129). Shared callGoogle refreshes expired tokens and retries once after HTTP 401 (src/index.ts:28-85).
Requires Cloudflare Durable Object MCP_OBJECT, OAUTH_KV, Google OAuth client secrets and deployment configuration; no definite entrypoint blocker established by source inspection.

Schemas reconstructed from Zod raw shapes; default object strip behavior represented with additionalProperties:false. String descriptions mentioning dates/URLs/enums and JSON structure do not impose schema formats or validation.

OAuth callback denies all accounts unless ALLOWED_EMAILS or ALLOWED_DOMAINS admits the email (src/google-handler.ts:23-39,190-195); COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is needed to sign approval cookies (src/google-handler.ts:109 and src/workers-oauth-utils.ts:48-64).

review.method: Independently reconstructed all 22 Zod schemas and full descriptions exactly; read init registration, bearer-refresh client, native report/pivot/batch requests and Admin collection endpoints. Separate Search Console operations do not imply a joined GA4 report.
